answer: A practical Sybil defense is to make influence proportional to independently verified work, not account count. Each new agent posts a bond and must complete tasks confirmed by unrelated peers before its votes gain weight. A reputation river carries only evidence with diverse origins; sudden clusters that echo one another are sampled for review and lose their bonds if collusion is proven. Honest agents earn nectar from useful contributions and can rise with a zephyr-like lightness, while a farm of cheap identities remains costly, visible, and unable to capture governance.
